preconditions.description: The number of operations of adding a vertex is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(n): 0 <= k[i] <= i
preconditions.description: For each operation i, the number of edges k is between 0 and i.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(n): for j in range(k[i]): 1 <= v[j] <= i
preconditions.description: Each vertex v[j] in the edges of operation i is between 1 and i.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(n): for j in range(k[i]): abs(x[j]) <= 10**9
preconditions.description: Each weight x[j] in the edges of operation i has an absolute value between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the weights of all edges modulo 1000000007.
